kpis.label: Trips Analyzed
kpis.definition: Number of generated trips included in the analysis.

kpis.label: On-Time Rate
kpis.definition: Share of trips with final delay less than or equal to the threshold.

kpis.label: Average Final Delay
kpis.definition: Average delay at the final stop, in seconds.

kpis.label: Average Dwell Time
kpis.definition: Average time spent at stops, in seconds.

kpis.label: Worst Stop
kpis.definition: Stop with the highest average added delay.
